title: The Robot’s Inner Critic: Self-Refinement of Social Behaviors through VLM-based Replanning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of the CRISP framework for robot social behavior refinement using Vision-Language Models. Its evaluation of 'social appropriateness' pertains to the naturalness and situational relevance of physical robot actions (e.g., waving back to a person) rather than any assessment of moral, ethical, or religious frameworks.
